# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rachel  <sub>[v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004), [v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017)</sub>; Mrs. Rachel Lynde  <sub>[v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

She is described as a stout or fat woman who waddles when she walks.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)_

## Personality

She is an outspoken, direct woman who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor. Though known as a confirmed busybody who can irritate others, she has a very kind heart, helps the poor, and is a forgiving neighbor. She is a dedicated, uncomplaining caretaker when loved ones are ill, as well as a passionate politician.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c9 P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## Traits

- Outspoken and opinionated
- Kind-hearted and charitable  <sub>[v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010)</sub>
- Ardent politician  <sub>[v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001)</sub>
- Fond of her own way  <sub>[v2 c26 P28](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0028)</sub>

## Abilities

- Experienced parent  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- Skilled and gentle nursing  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- To remain in Avonlea rather than leave her lifelong friends and home  <sub>[v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P27](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0027)</sub>

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived in Avonlea as a long-time neighbor and close friend of Marilla Cuthbert. Upon first meeting Anne Shirley, her blunt remarks about Anne's red hair and freckles provoked an intense outburst of temper from the girl, leading to initial friction before the two made peace. A passionate politician, she traveled to Charlottetown with her husband Thomas and Marilla to attend a political rally featuring the Canadian Premier. She also solicited local subscriptions to buy a carpet for her church vestry room, coming into conflict with Mr. Harrison over his refusal to donate. Following a prolonged illness, her husband Thomas passed away, leaving her in financial difficulties due to an old farm mortgage. Facing the heartbreaking prospect of leaving Avonlea, she gratefully accepted Marilla's invitation to move into Green Gables, taking up residence in the north gable with her own kitchen in the spare room while helping care for the Keith twins.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026)_

## Background by volume

- Brought up ten children and buried two  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- Lived as Marilla Cuthbert's neighbor for forty-five years without a quarrel  <sub>[v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017)</sub>
- Mortgaged her farm eight years prior to help her youngest son move west  <sub>[v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)</sub>

## Quotes

> Did anybody ever see such a temper!  <sub>[v1 c9 P21](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0021)</sub>

> Well, I don’t envy you your job bringing that up, Marilla.  <sub>[v1 c9 P24](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0024)</sub>

> I won’t meddle with you nor you with me, and as for the twins, I’ll be glad to do all I can for them; but I won’t undertake to answer Davy’s questions, that’s what. I’m not an encyclopedia, neither am I a Philadelphia lawyer.  <sub>[v2 c26 P29](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0029)</sub>


## Relationships

- Spouse of — Was a tender, patient, and unwearied nurse to her husband until his death.  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003)</sub>

- Friend of — Close friend and long-time neighbor of forty-five years who invited her to live at Green Gables.  <sub>[v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026)</sub>
